q: What's the difference between the web app and the Mac app?
a: Both scroll with your voice. The web app runs in a browser tab with no download. The Mac app adds a floating window that stays on top of every app and is excluded from screen sharing and recordings, 60+ languages, a script library, presets, stats and menu-bar controls.

q: Will other people see my script on a call?
a: On Mac, no. The prompter window is excluded from screen capture at the operating-system level, so Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, OBS, QuickTime and similar tools do not record it. Only you see it.

q: What happens if I go off-script?
a: Nothing breaks. The script waits while you improvise and picks up as soon as you return to the text. If you jump to another section, it jumps with you — forwards or backwards. You can also click any word to continue from there.

q: Can I add notes I don't want to read aloud?
